findings.finding: Packet scale values were used at Python-float precision before serialization but at float32 precision after parse-back, allowing one-round output drift.
findings.fix: PC1PosePacketV1 canonicalizes all scales to float32 at construction; exact decoded replay is a regression test.

findings.finding: The first composite-R check compared PC1 output with the parent and therefore could not causally attribute support to nonzero q.
findings.fix: The landed MS6 detector now compares the active zero-q home against a separately hashed nonzero probe packet.

findings.finding: The first 600x6 packet was 5,014 bytes and initialized an RGB-space warp from scorer-center directions, contradicting the task inbox solved-plane and byte-scale evidence.
findings.fix: The admitted owner is a 32-knot 40-byte zero home; #366 receives the exact parent-derived solved-plane YUV6 target, while the nonzero initialization is probe-only.

findings.finding: A structural active-tube observation could be misread as membership even though no descent ran.
findings.fix: The admission fence makes tube_claim false unless descent_was_run; both receipt rows explicitly report membership_claim=false.

findings.finding: The aggregate receipt recorded volatile free-space bytes, so an otherwise exact resume could not re-emit the same immutable receipt.
findings.fix: Storage preflight now records the stable predicate free_bytes_gte_required=true plus the fixed threshold and tier, while failing closed before receipt construction if the predicate is false.
